title: Identification of Biomarkers Associated with Heart Failure Caused by Idiopathic Dilated Cardiomyopathy Using WGCNA and Machine Learning Algorithms
summary: WGCNA, SVM-RFE and LASSO identified 13 candidate genes from idiopathic-dilated-cardiomyopathy heart-failure expression data. AQP3 and CYP2J2 showed diagnostic signal in GEO datasets GSE57338 and GSE6406, respectively; this is retrospective transcriptomic analysis, not clinical validation.
ai_technology: Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) narrowed candidate genes; SVM-RFE and LASSO selected biomarkers, then external GEO expression datasets checked AQP3 and CYP2J2.
